# Document structure golden set

Documents authored for this repository to check the structure the document readers and writers keep. They are not
copies of third-party files, so they carry no external licence: all files are released under the repository licence.

`build_docx_fixtures.py` writes the packages with Python's `zipfile` from XML strings that follow ECMA-376 Part 1
(17.3 paragraphs, 17.4 tables, 17.7 styles, 17.9 numbering, 17.11 footnotes and endnotes, 20.4 pictures). It imports
nothing from the converter. The pictures are generated by Pillow. Timestamps in the archives are fixed. The expected
structure of each document is written by hand in `tests/helpers/document-fixtures.ts`; it is never produced from a
converter's output. `python-docx` opens both files without error (`tests/document-fixtures.test.ts` checks this when
the package is installed).

| File | Holds | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rich-structure.docx` | Title, three heading styles and a style that inherits its heading level; nested decimal, letter and roman lists with a restart and a start value; nested bullet lists (symbol-font glyphs); an upper-roman list reached through a paragraph style; a table with a header row, a horizontal merge and a vertical merge; a hyperlink; bold, italic and underlined runs; a footnote and an endnote; a JPEG and a PNG with alternative text; a page break and a section break; core properties and page geometry | 57f8441efdf3b4c2c76d61cad82f73f935c16d1230c4ebebdea916e0de926fc8 |
| `merged-tables.docx` | One table whose cells merge horizontally and vertically (grid positions listed in `tests/docx-model-reader.test.ts`) | 1011a7e14b308c7c134cd2313545aa4c03a293f53080a77195be41964ebc8c7d |

The `SHA-256` column is checked by `tests/document-fixtures.test.ts`, so a changed file fails the suite. Regenerating
with another Pillow release can change the picture bytes; update the hashes in the same commit.
